allocation: Each selected stock 1/60 of post-fee NAV at original monthly rebalance; remainder cash with zero return; no intra-month cap reset
classification: medium=close[t-5]/close[t-60]-1, short=close[t]/close[t-5]-1; strictly positive/negative; zeros and missing explicitly unclassified
sample: Original E1 Q5 only; never fill up a state to 60 names
main_statistic: Complete calendar months; partial endpoint months shown separately in all-month sensitivity
win_definition: Net monthly account return > 1e-12; zero months remain in denominator and are separately counted
payoff_definition: Mean positive monthly return divided by absolute mean negative monthly return; not total gains/total losses
excess: Account monthly net return minus H00300 full-return index monthly return; exposure unmatched, not risk-adjusted alpha
evidence: Descriptive post-selection historical replay; Historical-proxy; month outcomes dependent; no significance claim
